claims.text: Often used in diabetes with predominant CV risk.
claims.quote: GLP-1 receptor agonists are often used in patients with diabetes and predominant cardiovascular risk.

claims.text: With established or high ASCVD risk, the plan should include a drug with proven CV-event benefit (eg, GLP-1 RA and/or SGLT2i).
claims.quote: 9.7 In adults with type 2 diabetes and established or high risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, the treatment plan should include medications with demonstrated benefits to reduce cardiovascular events (e.g., glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonist [GLP-1 RA] and/or sodium–glucose cotransporter 2 [SGLT2] inhibitor)

claims.text: Advanced CKD (eGFR < 30): GLP-1 RA preferred (lower hypoglycemia risk, CV-event reduction).
claims.quote: 9.11 In adults with type 2 diabetes and advanced CKD (eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2), a GLP-1 RA is preferred for glycemic management due to lower risk of hypoglycemia and for cardiovascular event reduction.
